If CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE , when a NM PDU is received where PNI bit and PNSR bit ar e 1 and the corresponding ComMChannel configured via CanNmComMNetworkHandleRef is actively coordinated ( ComMPncGatewayType set to COMM_GATEWAY_TYPE_ACTIVE ), CanNm module shall report the runtime error CANNM_E_INVALID_PN_SYNC_SHUTDOWN_REQUEST to DET , ignore the PNSR bit and handle the PDU as usual NM PDU.
